documents.title: Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI LODR
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Vadilal Industries reported 3% growth in reported revenues for FY19, while consolidated revenue grew 13% on an adjusted basis, driven by international expansion and strong demand from the Indian diaspora. Management highlighted margin expansion due to volume growth, benign raw material prices, and tight control over operating expenses, alongside plans for ongoing capital expenditure and price increases in the second half of the year to offset rising milk prices. The company continues to focus on debt rationalization, network expansion, and new product development across domestic and global markets. Vadilal Industries reported robust financial and operational performance for Q3 and 9M FY19, driven by strong growth in both domestic and international segments, particularly the US market. Management highlighted significant expansion in gross and EBITDA margins supported by higher volumes, lower raw material costs, and improved operational efficiencies.

guidance.claim: Management expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on regular capital expenditure during the year.
guidance.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.
guidance.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

guidance.claim: Estimated capex for FY 20 is approximately Rs. 30 crore.
guidance.quote:  Estimated capex for FY 20 at ~ Rs. 30 crore

guidance.claim: Management expects another good year in FY20 as they leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

guidance.claim: The company estimates capex for FY 19 at approximately Rs. 35 crore.
guidance.quote:  Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

demand_outlook.claim: International revenues continued to deliver encouraging expansion to cross the $ 20 million milestone, supported by 54% revenue growth during FY19.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues continued to deliver encouraging expansion to cross the $ 20 million milestone, on the back of 54% revenue growth during FY19.

demand_outlook.claim: International business is now over 25% of revenues, driven by strong demand for high quality ice creams and other products within the Indian diaspora in the U.S. and other geographies.
demand_outlook.quote: International business is now over 25% of revenues and growth is driven by strong demand for our high quality ice creams and other products within the sizeable Indian diaspora community in the U.S. and some other geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: The company started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.
demand_outlook.quote: We have started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is reverting to historical trends.
demand_outlook.quote: o Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

demand_outlook.claim: Latent demand for quality Indian products is driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales.
demand_outlook.quote: Latent demand for quality Indian products driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business growth is reverting to historical trends after being temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that Vadilal products currently reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states.
demand_outlook.quote: Currently, Vadilal products reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states and we remain committed to expand the network judiciously.

demand_outlook.claim: International revenues contributed 32% to the turnover during Q2.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues contributed 32% to the turnover during Q2 and continue to expand rapidly with Vadilal ice cream and processed foods products finding positive demand pull from the Indian diaspora in the US and other key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Going forward, management maintains a positive business outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: Going forward, we maintain our positive business outlook – better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector and continued traction in international business.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has committed distribution investments in multiple locations in the U.S. to allow widespread access to the Indian diaspora.
capex_expansion.quote: We have already committed distribution investments in multiple locations in the U.S. that allow us widespread access to the sizeable Indian diaspora in key target markets.

capex_expansion.claim: No major capital expenditure is anticipated on capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote:  No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

capex_expansion.claim: The estimated capex for FY19 is approximately Rs. 35 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year driven by volume growth, benign raw material prices, and larger contribution from international operations.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year on the back of volume growth, benign raw material prices and larger contribution from international operations, where realizations are significantly higher.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, driven by U.S. operations having a base of over 50 employees.
margins_costs.quote: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations that now have a base of over 50 employees.

margins_costs.claim: Management kept a tight control on other operating expenses, leaving them almost unchanged.
margins_costs.quote: However, we have kept a tight control on other operating expenses that remained almost unchanged.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.

margins_costs.claim: Based on raw material purchase and inventory position, the company has visibility of stable costs covered till Q2.
margins_costs.quote: Based on our raw material purchase and inventory position, we have visibility of stable costs covered till Q2.

margins_costs.claim: As milk prices are at higher levels now, the company will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.
margins_costs.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have continued to expand – gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: On a nine-month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.
margins_costs.quote: On nine month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin increased by over ~1,000 bps during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have improved significantly during the quarter – gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices continue to be subdued for the next season, which should benefit margins.
margins_costs.quote: We have been engaging with raw material suppliers for the next season and prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.

margins_costs.claim: International ice cream sales come with higher realizations and contribution margins.
margins_costs.quote: International ice cream sales come with higher realizations and contribution margins, which is also helping improve profits while increasing utilization of current capacities.
